description:
Produce a correctly signed MAX mini-app initData string (two-step HMAC with 'WebAppData') for backend tests,
    with the token used, so you can check your validator end to end.

age_seconds.description: Make auth_date this many seconds old, to test expiry
age_seconds.title: Age Seconds

lang.description: Answer language: 'en' English, 'ru' Russian. Pick the user's language; default ru (or XONTA_MAX_LANG)
lang.title: Lang

test_bot_token.description: A TEST token to sign with. Omit to generate a random one. Never pass a production token to a hosted server
test_bot_token.title: Test Bot Token

name: max_mock_init_data
